meta.title: autoVet | Veterinary clinic scheduling
meta.description: Clear, compliant, explainable scheduling for veterinary clinics

hero.title: Every shift, thoughtfully covered.
hero.subtitle: Turn staffing, leave and preferences into compliant, explainable schedules.
hero.legal: Schedules are planning assistance. An administrator must confirm labor-law and contract compliance.

staff.title: Who is working this month?
staff.hint: Add doctors and nurses, then set weekly target hours.
staff.hintDoctorOnly: Only doctors and backup doctors will be included in this schedule. Nurse profiles remain saved.
staff.name: Name
staff.empty: Add at least one doctor and one nurse.

rules.title: Set clinic coverage
rules.coverageGroupHelp: Choose the month, normal staffing, popular-day overrides, and clinic opening rules.
rules.availabilityGroupHelp: Set preferred workdays and recurring unavailable weekdays for each doctor.
rules.compatibilityGroupHelp: Configure doctor pairs that should or must not share a shift.
rules.leaveGroupHelp: Add individual dates when employees cannot work.
rules.coworkerGroupHelp: Record which employees prefer working together.
rules.doctorOnlyHelp: Build a doctor roster without nurse coverage.
rules.doctorNurseHelp: Build one combined roster covering both roles.
rules.singleDoctorWeekdaysHelp: Every session on selected weekdays will have at most one doctor.
rules.singleDoctorConflict: Set doctors per session to 1 before using one-doctor weekdays.
rules.popularDaysHelp: Choose one or more busy shifts and override their normal minimum staffing on selected weekdays.
rules.popularDayConflict: A popular-day doctor minimum exceeds the allowed maximum for that weekday.
rules.flexHelp: Enable only after legally required union or labor-management approval.
rules.attest: I confirm the clinic has the required approval
rules.doctorWeeklyPreferencesHelp: Select recurring weekdays each doctor cannot work and their preferred number of workdays.
rules.incompatibleDoctorsHelp: Doctors in a pair will never be assigned to the same session.

generate.title: Compare feasible schedules
generate.noResult: These constraints cannot produce a complete schedule. Add staff or adjust leave.

schedule.highlightHint: Click to highlight every shift for this person.
schedule.daySwapHint: Drag one date header onto another. All morning, afternoon, and evening assignments are exchanged.
schedule.swapMonth: Every matching weekday in the month
schedule.dragDayHint: Drag this day onto another day to swap schedules

export.title: Your schedule is ready
export.summaryHint: AI summarizes the result and never changes assignments.
export.editHint: Double-click a name to replace that person and edit the plan.
export.summaryDoctorOnly: This option balances target hours for {count} doctors while maintaining at least {doctors} doctor(s) per session. AI can summarize coworker preferences after selection.
export.summaryCombined: This option balances target hours for {count} team members while maintaining at least {doctors} doctor(s) and {nurses} nurse(s) per session. AI can summarize coworker preferences after selection.

history.title: Schedule history
history.subtitle: Find past schedules by month, employee, or status.
